notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي» — the father is named by relation and «جماعة مشايخي» is an unnamed group of shaykhs, co-transmitters in one level (rule 8)

«أَصْبَحْنا لَيْلَةَ قُتِلَ الْحُسَيْنُ» is Amr ibn Ikrima's own first-person narration, and the saying is a caller's verse that a «مولى لنا» reports in the scene: the transmission of the verse from the mawla is implicit (rule 11, first-person narrative with implicit transmission); the reading ends at عمرو بن عكرمة
The number «10» at the start is a label and is left out
